programs.title: Horton Hears a Who!
programs.desc: In the jungle of Nool lives the elephant Horton, who has a vivid imagination and an angelic disposition.One day he hears a tiny particle floating in the air calling for help.It turns out that the city of Whosiowo, inhabited by microscopic Whos, is located on the pollen.The power here is held by Mayor Ned, who confesses to Horton that the city is in danger of destruction.He, in turn, tells the jungle inhabitants about this, but no one wants to believe him.The cynical Kanga even thinks that the honest elephant has lost his mind.Also the black eagle Vlad-I-Koff and the monkey clan of Wickershams mock him.Even Horton's best friend, Morton, doesn't believe what he says.Despite this, the elephant decides to save the inhabitants of Whosiów.

programs.title: Down with Love
programs.desc: The 1960s.Writer Barbara Novak (Renée Zellweger) comes to New York to publish her book To Hell with Love.The author convinces women to focus on their careers and treat sex and feelings the same way as men.Editor Vicki Hiller (Sarah Paulson) tries to set her up with the famous journalist, Catcher Block (Ewan McGregor), but none of the several meetings takes place.Eventually, Barbara's book gains popularity and becomes a bestseller.Then the roles are reversed and Novak rejects Block's subsequent proposals to meet.An angry journalist, whom the author called "the worst type of man" in a TV program, decides to take revenge on her.He begins to pose as astronaut Zip Martin to make her fall in love with him and ridicule her theory.He does not know that he himself is becoming an object of manipulation.

programs.title: A Real Pain
programs.desc: American David Kaplan (Jesse Eisenberg) and his cousin Benji (Kieran Culkin) set off on an expedition to Poland.They want to honor the memory of their beloved grandmother Dora.They begin their tour of her home country by joining the team of British guide James (Will Sharpe).Members of the group with Jewish roots visit places related to the history and culture of their ancestors.During the journey, tensions grow between the young men resulting from their different approaches to life.The director and screenwriter of the comedy-drama is Jesse Eisenberg, who also starred in the main role.He called his film "a love letter to Poland".His acting duo, Kieran Culkin, was awarded a Golden Globe.The photos were shot, among others, in Warsaw and Lublin.

programs.title: Priscilla
programs.desc: Young Elvis Presley (Jacob Elrodi) meets teenage Priscilla Beaulieu (Cailee Spaeny).He begins to prepare the girl for the role of his future wife.Over time, a serious feeling develops between them.However, life in the spotlight exposes their relationship to numerous tests, including from the star's numerous lovers.Priscilla, living detached from reality, slowly begins to learn about herself.Will her transformation affect the future of this marriage?Sofia Coppola returns with another story about female youth."Priscilla" is the result of the director's cooperation with the ex-wife of the American rock star, Elvis Presley.The director of "Curses of Innocence" and "Temptation" once again juxtaposes passion, romance and great love with the cruel realities of life.

programs.title: Arrival
programs.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programs.title: Destiny
programs.desc: The development of science and the emergence of time travel provide a chance to avoid the largest bomb attack in history.The explosion had occurred in New York ten years earlier.The risky task is undertaken by a secret government agency headed by Robertson.He realizes the danger.Since any interference with past events can irreversibly change the present, he develops a plan to eliminate the terrorist without side effects.He chooses a random agent to carry out the mission.He is to recruit a younger version of the criminal into his organization.At the same time, he makes surprising discoveries about himself.

programs.title: Macbeth
programs.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programs.title: A Complete Unknown
programs.desc: The year is 1961. Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan (Timothée Chalamet) from Minnesota visits his idol - folk singer Woody Guthrie (Scoot McNairy) in the hospital.The artist suffering from Huntington's disease is cared for by his friend, Pete Seeger (Edward Norton).An aspiring musician has the opportunity to present one of his songs to experienced performers.They notice his talent.Thanks to the recommendation of a scene veteran, Dylan begins performing in New York folk clubs.On his way, he meets, among others, Joan Baez (Monica Barbaro), with whom he begins cooperation and, over time, also a romance.An aura of mystery, charisma and talent lead him to the peak of popularity.The breakthrough in his career was his performance at the Newport Folk Festival in 1965.The story of the life of a music icon.The director focused on the years 1961-1965.The film received eight Oscar nominations.Actors competing for the statuette included Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton and Monica Barbaro.

programs.title: Den sidste viking
programs.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programs.title: Insomnia
programs.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Police officer Will Dormer (Al Pacino) arrives in the town of Nightmute with his partner Hap Eckhart (Martin Donovan).The men are to find the perpetrator of the murder of a seventeen-year-old girl.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.The trail leads to writer Walter Finch (Robin Williams), who was friends with the victim.While chasing him in the thick fog, Will shoots his partner.Hap dies.In his last words, he accuses Will of doing it to prevent an internal investigation.Dormer covers his tracks by directing suspicions at Finch.A writer who witnessed Hap's murder begins to blackmail Will.Meanwhile, local policewoman Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank) is getting closer to discovering the truth about Hap's death.

programs.title: 28 Days Later...
programs.desc: A deadly virus was bred in one of the laboratories in Great Britain.A group of animal activists breaks in and frees the monkeys that were being studied.The animals, mad with rage, attack their saviors.The infected person loses control within 12 seconds and becomes a bloodthirsty beast.The epidemic is spreading extremely quickly throughout the country.28 days later, Jim (Cillian Murphy) wakes up from a coma while lying in the intensive care unit of a London hospital.Not understanding what happened, he wanders the deserted streets of the city.The terrified man is attacked by groups of angry people.He is saved from trouble by Selena (Naomie Harris) and Mark (Noah Huntley).All three escape from the city and end up at a military base commanded by Major Henry West (Christopher Eccleston).However, they are not safe there either.

programs.title: Ghostlight
programs.desc: Grieving construction worker Dan (Keith Kupferer) joins a local theater group working on a production of Romeo and Juliet.There are changes in his life.
